requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: Apprentice base per Art. G includes ITS and EVR alongside paga_base + contingenza. Engine covers only paga_base + contingenza; apprentice gross is understated where ITS applies.
requirements.remediation: Add ITS and EVR to the apprentice base of Art. G.

requirements.rule: CASSA EDILE: the operai are owed the gratifica natalizia and the ferie as a 18.5% of the pay paid to the Edilcassa (Art. 16 and 18), not a tredicesima from the employer; the file pays them a direct 13th month, so the net, the employer cost and the Edilcassa contribution are all off.
requirements.remediation: Model the operai in a file of their own with 12 monthly payments and the 18.5% Edilcassa accrual, as edilizia-ance does.

requirements.rule: The Art. 65 loyalty award is paid on the hire anniversary after twenty years, but non-disciplinary dismissal pro rata (whole-month twelfths since the last award) is not calculated on a termination run.
requirements.remediation: Calculate the full-month twelfths due on non-disciplinary dismissal after entitlement.

requirements.rule: Art. 65 does not specify the anniversary of a hire on 29 February in a common year; the engine uses 28 February.
requirements.remediation: Source the anniversary rule for a 29 February hire before changing the fallback.

requirements.rule: SIMPLIFICATION: Apprenticeship destination conflicts. Art. G defines 4 operai groups and 3 impiegati bands. Engine tracks use disjoint destination_levels: level '2' -> gruppo_4 (36m); level '3' -> gruppo_3 (48m, ref=L2); levels '4'/'5' -> gruppo_2 (51m, ref=L3); levels '6'/'7' -> gruppo_1 (60m, ref=L3). Level '1' has no apprenticeship track (manual labor). Operai gruppo_3 (also exits at level '2', 48m) not modelled separately.
requirements.remediation: Model the operai gruppo 3 track (48 months, exit at level 2) separately and select it by track name.

requirements.rule: SENIORITY: Art. 49 (testo armonizzato 15/04/2025, p. 87) gives the scatti to 'L'impiegato' only, by category; the operai accrue the Anzianità professionale edile of Art. 29 (p. 64) through the Fondo Unico APE, out of an employer contribution 'nella misura stabilita per ciascuna circoscrizione territoriale'. The engine pays no scatti to a worker stated as operaio (seniority excluded_categories); the territorial APE contribution is not modelled, a run of levels 1-4 that does not state the category still pays the Art. 49 amounts, and level 1 has no Art. 49 amount (8.22 of the Impiegati 4a is used). Level 1 holds the impiegati di 4ª categoria di primo impiego: art. 49 (p. 87) gives 'Impiegati 4ª 8,22', the amount modelled for level 1 (filleacgil copy sha256 25828567c377c4892c46d6e1c47734aef275933f4a3619ee74dc424fd080dcba).
requirements.remediation: Add the territorial APE contribution (Fondo Unico APE) of the worker's circoscrizione as an employer cost.

requirements.rule: EVR (Elemento Variabile della Retribuzione): conditional, company/territory-specific bonus. Not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Add the provincial EVR as an input.
Verify the value on its primary source and record the provenance; a derivation states its formula and inputs.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded. A CCNL whose comporto the engine counts over the calendar year (Commercio Art. 186 and the others with comporto_calendar_year) is not affected.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: SICK PAY OF THE IMPIEGATI (Art. 66, PDF pp. 96-97): full pay for 6 months, then 50% for the next 3 (2 to 6 years of seniority) or 75% for 3 and 50% for 3 (above 6 years), and for the 3 additional months of several illnesses the first in full and the others at 50%; the engine pays every day of the comporto in full.
requirements.remediation: Pay the 75% and 50% months of art. 66 by seniority after the first 6 months of sickness.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: ITS (Indennita' Territoriale di Settore) not modelled: varies by province/region. National table footnote: 'A questa Tabella occorre aggiungere l'ITS che varia da territorio a territorio'. The national tabular minimum does not include ITS.
requirements.remediation: Model the ITS with a fact naming the province, or take it as a second-level element, then remove this limitation.
